title: Retire active `craze` canonical language in favor of Vaporize while preserving compatibility aliases
createdBy: Chief of Staff (clia) per chairman drift-catch order after Vaporize/Warehouse core win

historicalContent.createdBy: Chief of Staff (clia) per chairman drift-catch order after Vaporize/Warehouse core win
historicalContent.description: Migrate active, forward-looking `craze` surfaces to Vaporize language without destroying historical provenance or breaking compatibility aliases. The tool's physical package path and legacy executable may remain `craze` for compatibility, but active doctrine, open beads, receipt names, command examples, and operator-facing prose must use Vaporize as the canonical build/collapse gate.

driftFound.requiredDisposition: RESOLVED 2026-06-11 — bead renamed to FR-VAPORIZE-LIST-TARGETS at the new vaporize@wrkstrm-core.cli home per operator OD-N (directory rename). Old slug preserved here as historical reference.

Filename retained as historical FR-CRAZE-* slug per disposition (supersede via vaporize-realize-typed-vaporware-unit.issue.json). Containing directory moved to vaporize@wrkstrm-core.cli per operator OD-N 2026-06-11.
Treat existing receipts as historical; future receipt home should be vaporize-collapse-receipts or Warehouse-owned receipt refs.
Mark superseded by vaporize-builds-vaporware-warehouse-stores-vaporware.axiom.su.json or stop citing it as current doctrine.

acceptanceCriteria: Every open Vaporize package bead uses Vaporize in title, description, acceptance criteria, and command examples unless explicitly describing compatibility.
Old `FR-CRAZE-*` beads are either renamed, superseded, or linked forward to their `FR-VAPORIZE-*` successor.
Future receipt schemas and folders use Vaporize naming or Warehouse-owned receipt refs.
`x-vaporize-collapse-path` is documented as canonical; `x-craze-collapse-path` remains supported as legacy only.
Historical fan-in drafts are left intact but are not used as current doctrine without successor references.
